trust_decision.summary: HeaderUtils::split() runs one preg_match_all tokenizer over an untrusted header value; the regex's nested quantifiers and whitespace lookbehind (not a decision but a cost bound) decide whether attacker-controlled header text is parsed in linear time.

landing_point.why: The advisory names HeaderUtils::split() directly; the only regex in it is the preg_match_all tokenizer.

fix_sites.entry_point: HeaderBag::set('Cache-Control', ...) / new HeaderBag(...) from Request::createFromGlobals -> HeaderBag::parseCacheControl -> HeaderUtils::split (HeaderUtils.php:53-69 at pinned)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: None useful: every caller (Cache-Control, Forwarded, Accept*, Cookie, X-Accel-Mapping) reaches the same single regex, so one fix inside split() closes all of them.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Quoted-string handling, separator precedence, trimming of surrounding whitespace and inner-space joining ('foo "bar"' -> 'foo bar'), and cookie values with embedded '=' must keep the existing split() results; a rewrite that drops the whitespace rules breaks the existing provider cases.

O6_input_shapes: long whitespace runs inside an unquoted token
whitespace used as a separator character (the follow-up fix in fix.diff:16-18, tests fix.diff:30-33)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: If-None-Match split with preg_split('/\s*,\s*/') on a raw request header, a second tokenizer outside HeaderUtils
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Hand-rolled header split next to HeaderUtils; a maintainer could plausibly write a richer quoted-ETag regex here with the same whitespace idiom.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Vary header split with preg_split('/[\s,]+/') could be replaced by a split()-like tokenizer with its own quoted-string/whitespace regex
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Header-list parsing that sits outside HeaderUtils, so a local copy of the tokenizer would read as natural.

O10_build.project_tests: Tests/HeaderUtilsTest.php (testSplit data provider at Tests/HeaderUtilsTest.php:20-62), plus HeaderBagTest/AcceptHeaderTest/CookieTest callers

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Cap the Cache-Control header length in HeaderBag::parseCacheControl instead of making the split() regex linear, which leaves Forwarded/Accept/Cookie callers open.

out_of_scope_notes: Response.php:1347 matches '/MSIE (.*?);/i' against User-Agent; separate regex in a legacy IE path, not this advisory's sink.
